scenarios.name: marathon-epic
scenarios.prompt: Work through the expedition permit workflow on the site I have open, from station 1 to station 120. Each station page shows its dispatch word and seal. At every station, enter the dispatch word shown on that page plus the receipt from the previous station (station 1 shows a start receipt), submit the station form, and carry the new receipt to the next station via the link. Complete all 120 stations in order without re-submitting a station that was already accepted, finish on the completion page, and tell me the permit ID.

reasons: all 120 stations recorded exactly once, in order, with the requested values; the permit completion view is the final state

turn.finalText:
DONE — **Permit ID: EXP-120Q**

- All 120 stations were accepted in order (station 1 with `START-E1`/`basecamp`, then each station's dispatch word plus the previous station's receipt, continuing via each "Continue to station N" link); final receipt was `R120-T9W`.
- Verified on the completion page: "Permit issued. Permit ID: EXP-120Q — All 120 stations accepted. The workflow is complete."
- One note: my first submit attempt at station 11 went in with a duplicated word and was rejected ("Nothing was recorded"); I resubmitted it correctly and it was accepted, so nothing was double-recorded.

reasons: all 120 stations recorded exactly once, in order, with the requested values; the permit completion view is the final state
